snippet.title: 5 minutes of Frogrammer gameplay
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3584240/Frogrammer/

Frogrammer is a real-time auto-battler where you command your army of programming frogs to fight evil capitalist bugs. Manage your resources, leverage synergies, exploit enemy weaknesses and fight your way to the source of the horde. Hold on to your tadpoles and SQUASH.THE.BUGS.
